title: Gamma COVID Variant Devastates Manaus
note: Confirmed: P.1 (Gamma) variant emerged Manaus January 2021; oxygen shortage crisis documented.

title: Senate Inquiry Into Bolsonaro's Pandemic Response
note: CPI conducted 2021; recommended crimes against humanity charges. Confirmed.

title: Brazil Records Peak COVID Death Tolls
note: Confirmed: daily death tolls exceeded 4,000 at peak in April 2021.

title: Brazil Misses Paris Agreement Deforestation Targets
note: Confirmed: Brazil's deforestation accelerated under Bolsonaro, missing Paris commitment targets.

title: Brazil's Amazon Fund Reactivated After Suspension
note: Amazon Fund frozen 2019; steps toward reactivation discussed 2021; fully reactivated 2022–2023 under Lula.

title: Petrópolis Floods and Landslides Kill Over 230
note: Confirmed: February 15, 2022; over 230 killed; deadliest disaster in region since 2011.

title: Lula Defeats Bolsonaro in Closest Election in Decades
note: Confirmed: Lula won 50.9% vs Bolsonaro 49.1%; margin was ~1.8 percentage points. Closest in Brazilian democratic history.

title: Amazon Deforestation Reaches 15-Year High
note: Confirmed: 2021 (Bolsonaro's term) saw highest deforestation in 15 years; 11,568 sq km. The 2022 figure is close; confirmed as high during Bolsonaro's final year.

title: Petrobras Pre-Salt Output Reaches Record Levels
note: Pre-salt production records set in 2022; Brazil in top-10 oil producers. Confirmed.

title: Brazil Celebrates 200 Years of Independence
note: Confirmed: bicentennial September 7, 2022; Bolsonaro used it as campaign event; divided commemoration documented.

title: Bolsonaro Supporters Storm Government Buildings in Brasilia
note: Confirmed: January 8, 2023; Presidential Palace, Congress, Supreme Court stormed; hundreds arrested.

title: Lula Inaugurated for Third Presidential Term
note: Confirmed: inaugurated January 1, 2023; sash from ordinary citizens. Immediate reversal of Bolsonaro environmental policies confirmed.

title: Amazon Deforestation Drops Sharply Under Lula
note: Confirmed: ~50% drop in Amazon deforestation in 2023 compared to 2022.

title: Yanomami Indigenous Health Crisis Declared
note: Confirmed: public health emergency declared January 2023; malnutrition and malaria crisis; illegal gold miners expelled.

title: Brazil Rejoins Paris Climate Agreement Commitments
note: Lula's government rejoined and strengthened Paris commitments in 2023. Confirmed.

title: Uncontacted Yanomami Groups Emerge Amid Health Crisis
note: Health emergency revealed severe conditions among recently contacted groups due to gold mining. Confirmed.

title: Brazil Chairs G20 with Social Inclusion Agenda
note: Confirmed: Brazil held G20 presidency 2024; Rio summit November 2024; hunger, climate finance, wealth tax as priorities.

title: Catastrophic Floods Devastate Rio Grande do Sul
note: Confirmed: 183 deaths, ~600,000 displaced. Event says 'over 150 people' and '500,000' — both are accurate (183 is over 150; ~600,000 displaced is close to the 500,000 cited).

title: Bolsonaro Indicted for Alleged Coup Plot
note: Confirmed: federal police concluded investigation finding evidence of coup plot including alleged assassination plan against Lula.

title: Amazon Drought and Fires Reach Record Severity
note: Confirmed: 2024 Amazon drought and fires reached record severity; river dolphin deaths documented.

title: Brazil Hosts COP30 Preparation Begins in Belem
note: COP30 hosted in Belém, Brazil, November 2025. Preparations and city infrastructure began in 2024. Confirmed.

title: Brazil Proposes Global Wealth Tax at G20
note: Confirmed: Brazil championed global wealth tax proposal backed by Gabriel Zucman at G20; no binding commitment achieved.

title: Lula Government Faces Congressional Setbacks
note: Conservative Congress rolled back indigenous land protections and environmental rules in 2023–2024. Confirmed.
